# design-os-github-page

> Universal zero-dependency GitHub Pages template, CLI scaffolder, and 9-tier layout engine with built-in SEO, XML Sitemap, llms.txt (GEO), and Schema.org FAQPage (AEO).

Author-grade GitHub Pages marketing & documentation engine for builders and AI coding agents.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-github-page/): Main project overview, features, and evidence.
- [Repository](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-github-page): GitHub repository, source code, and release tags.

## Core Features & Architecture

- **Primary Interface**: CLI and programmatic API.
- **Verification Gates**: Rigorous automated checks with reproducible evidence.
- **Deterministic Workflows**: Predictable outputs and contract enforcement.
